name: Microcephalic Primordial Dwarfism Syndrome with Combined Immunodeficiency due to PRIM1 Deficiency
aliases: PRIM1-related Microcephalic Primordial Dwarfism with Immunodeficiency

criteria.description: Severe congenital microcephaly with head circumference significantly below the 3rd percentile
Severe prenatal and postnatal growth retardation consistent with primordial dwarfism
Laboratory evidence of combined immunodeficiency including lymphopenia and impaired T and B cell function
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the PRIM1 gene
Characteristic facial features including prominent nose and micrognathia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all major criteria including microcephaly, primordial dwarfism, combined immunodeficiency, and genetic confirmation of PRIM1 mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires molecular genetic testing to confirm PRIM1 deficiency

pathognomonic.notes: Head circumference well below the 3rd percentile at birth
searchTerms: very small head size at birth

pathognomonic.notes: Marked prenatal and postnatal growth retardation
searchTerms: extremely small body size from birth

pathognomonic.symptomName: Combined immunodeficiency with T and B cell dysfunction
pathognomonic.notes: Severe lymphopenia and impaired adaptive immunity
searchTerms: immune deficiency affecting T and B cells
poor antibody and T cell response

common.symptomName: Recurrent severe bacterial and viral infections
Facial dysmorphism including micrognathia and prominent nose
common.notes: Characteristic facial features aiding clinical recognition
Likely secondary to immunodeficiency or malabsorption

occasional.notes: Skin manifestations related to immune dysregulation
Enlargement of liver and spleen due to immune activation
Mild to moderate anemia secondary to chronic illness

laboratory: Lymphopenia with reduced T and B lymphocyte counts
imaging: Brain MRI showing microcephaly with simplified gyral pattern
Skeletal survey demonstrating severe growth retardation
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic variants in PRIM1 gene confirmed by molecular testing
other: Abnormal immunophenotyping consistent with combined immunodeficiency

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of skeletal dysplasia with characteristic radiographic changes
Profound immunodeficiency without microcephaly or primordial dwarfism
Different genetic causes (e.g., IL2RG, ADA mutations)
Early onset severe infections without growth retardation

redFlags: Severe congenital microcephaly with growth retardation
Failure to thrive despite adequate nutrition
references: Orphanet: Microcephalic Primordial Dwarfism Syndrome with Combined Immunodeficiency due to PRIM1 Deficiency, ORPHA:718037
